tools.name: studio_options
tools.description: START HERE for any custom-print request: the menu of generation choices (print placements with plain-language descriptions, products, backgrounds, engines+costs). Present these to the human — at minimum ask which PLACEMENT and which PRODUCT they want — before calling studio_generate.
tools.title: Custom print options

tools.name: studio_generate
tools.description: Generate a CUSTOM t-shirt print from a text prompt (AI, takes 2-10 min). SPENDS THE ACCOUNT OWNER'S STUDIO CREDITS: tell them the cost and their balance and get a yes BEFORE calling this — never spend silently, and never spend to 'try something' on your own initiative. Credits are earned (20 free on signup, 20 with every tee bought), so a wasted one is a real loss to them. Free exception: preserve=true prints their own image as-is and costs nothing. IMPORTANT: first call studio_options and ask the human to pick placement + product (and optionally background); do NOT silently use defaults. Args: prompt (design description), product? (one of ['kids_basic_tshirt_boy', 'kids_basic_tshirt_girl', 'kids_oversize_tshirt_boy', 'kids_oversize_tshirt_girl', 'mens_basic_tshirt', 'mens_oversize_tshirt', 'womens_basic_tshirt', 'womens_oversize_tshirt']), background? (t-shirt background, one of ['washed-beige', 'washed-black', 'washed-blue', 'washed-brown', 'washed-gray', 'washed-green', 'washed-orange', 'washed-pink', 'washed-red', 'washed-yellow', 'watercolor-beige', 'watercolor-blue', 'watercolor-sky']), placement? (print size/position, one of ['portrait_extended', 'square_center', 'chest_small']), model? (nb2 default | gpt-image-2 — both 1 credit, different styles), image_url? (https link to the user's OWN image — used as style/subject reference), preserve? (true = print the user's image exactly as-is, no AI redraw — kids' drawings, own art; FREE, no credits; requires image_url). Returns print_id — poll studio_status until done.

prompt.description: Text description of the design to generate.

product.description: Studio product base from studio_options (default mens_oversize_tshirt).

placement.description: Print size/position: portrait_extended (default), square_center or chest_small.

model.description: Generation engine: nb2 (default) or gpt-image-2 — both 1 credit.

image_url.description: https link to the user's OWN image, used as style/subject reference.

preserve.description: true = print the image exactly as-is, no AI redraw (free); requires image_url.

tools.title: Generate custom print

print_id.description: Generation id — poll studio_status with it.

tell_user.description: Say this to the account owner — what was spent from their balance and what is left.

studio_account_created.description: Present when a Studio account was auto-created for the user.

error.description: e.g. not enough Studio credits, daily limit reached, invalid product.

topup_url.description: Where the user can buy credits (present on 'not enough credits').

tools.name: submit_design
tools.description: Send one of the designer's own artworks for moderation. TWO inputs, same path: either artwork files — front/back accept a public image URL OR an upload_id from designer_upload_slot — or session_id of a FINISHED Studio session of theirs (generated with studio_generate; no need to download the print, we fetch it server-side). Args: name (required), front OR session_id (one of them), back?, layout? ('front_back' default, or 'r10' for a ready print-side file), note?, batch? (same string across a bulk run so the moderator sees them as one batch). Minimum 2048px on the short side. IMPORTANT for the designer: this queues the artwork for moderation — catalog listing follows production and is not instant.

front.description: Image URL or upload_id. Omit when passing session_id.

session_id.description: Finished Studio session of this designer (print_id from studio_generate). Alternative to front.
